verdict.rationale: Square documents the building blocks of a payment flow. It has card-payment and Web Payments SDK docs, a Sandbox with sandbox payments, idempotency guidance, and an interactive API Explorer against Sandbox resources. The official TypeScript/Node SDK shows copy-paste snippets for client setup and `client.payments.create`. However, only one language's examples are evidenced, and nothing corroborates that a working flow can be built in under a day. missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste examples across multiple languages (beyond TypeScript/Node), an end-to-end quickstart walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration of sub-day integration time.
